sources.title: Boğaziçi University 2026–2027 food-service procurement — IKN 2025/1727143
supports: current two-year Boğaziçi food-service procurement scope and contractor discovery
public notice requires bidder capacity report sufficient for at least 5,000 meals/day (qualification threshold, not actual production)
public notice states economically most advantageous offer is determined on price basis
public result reports 14 bids, 7 valid bids, contract dated 25.12.2025 and TEMAŞ as contractor
public notice states bids are submitted as item quantity × unit price and the awarded contract is a unit-price contract
public notice describes 5,000 meals/day capacity as one-half of the administration's stated daily meal need for bidder qualification
limitations: does not reveal unit-price schedule, hakediş, penalties or service-level quantity mechanics
5,000 meals/day is a bidder qualification threshold, not evidence of actual daily production or committed quantity
unit-price contract form does not reveal the actual unit-price schedule or which operational count is accepted for payment
the notice's daily-need framing is procurement/capacity context, not measured actual served demand
